plan: My private value is $27. In a second-price sealed auction, the optimal strategy is typically to bid my true value. Since the third-highest bid determines the payment, bidding exactly $27 ensures I maximize potential profit. With neutral risk tolerance, I want to capture the full surplus if my bid wins. Other bidders might bid strategically above or below their value, so a true-value bid provides a balanced approach.
